newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Amcoal cautious on current year earnings.
newsitem.headline: Amcoal cautious on current year earnings.

text.p: Anglo American Coal Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it expected only a small improvement in earnings in the year ahead.
Amcoal chairman David Rankin said that while some increase in export tonnage is planned for the year ahead, U.S. dollar coal prices are forecast to be marginally lower.
He said that assuming a relatively unchanged rand dollar exchange rate, a reduction in export earnings could be anticipated.

Increased tonnages are planned from collieries supplying Eskom and the inland market. Amcoal's Verref division is forecasting increased earnings flowing from improved market conditions, increased efficiencies and the introduction of new products, he said.
"With this operational background and with interest income expected to be higher, it is anticipated that Amcoal's earnings for the year ahead will show marginal improvement," Rankin said.
